VT1 (Ventilatory Threshold 1) is the point during exercise where breathing starts increasing faster than oxygen consumption. 🫁🏃‍♂️ At VT1, the body begins producing more carbon dioxide due to increased energy demand, causing ventilation to rise noticeably. Talking during exercise becomes slightly difficult, but the activity is still sustainable for a longer duration. 💨🔥 This stage marks the shift from easy to moderate intensity exercise and is important for improving aerobic endurance and cardiovascular fitness. 🚴‍♂️❤️ Train smart, understand your thresholds, and boost your performance! 💪✨      SportsScience Fitness AerobicTraining Workout Physiology
